# AG Algo Lab — Anthony Gocmen

> Anthony Gocmen, founder of AG Algo Lab. Whole platforms, not pages: public site, member areas, payments, automation, SEO, data — and the automations that keep running after the hand-over. Two products in production. Built with Claude Code. English at the root, French under /fr/.

Contact: anthony@agalgolab.com

## Pages

- [What does a website or a web platform cost?](https://agalgolab.com/prix-plateforme-web/) (en) : A showcase website from €500 to €1,250, everything included. A platform with accounts and payments: per active member or flat fee. What moves the price.

- [Reversal Engine: price reversals, in real time](https://agalgolab.com/reversal-engine/) (en) : A personal research system that detects price reversals on SOL and BTC on 15-minute candles, sends the signal to Telegram and places the order.
- [Reversal Engine : les retournements de prix, en temps réel](https://agalgolab.com/fr/reversal-engine/) (fr) : Un système de recherche personnel qui détecte des retournements de prix sur SOL et BTC en 15 minutes, envoie le signal sur Telegram et passe l'ordre.
